title: Campsis Settings JSON Schema

replicates.description: Number of replicates. Optional, defaults to 1.

name.description: Name of the output function (used for labeling the Campsis output). This name is optional. If not provided, the default name will be 'pi_<variable>_<pi_level>'

variable.description: Variable for which the prediction interval is computed

strata.description: Named strata filters used to subset the Campsis output. See outfun_strata definition.

name.description: Name of the output function (used for labeling the Campsis output). This name is optional. If not provided, the default name will be 'stats_<variable>'

variable.description: Variable for which the prediction interval is computed

strata.description: Named strata filters used to subset the Campsis output. See outfun_strata definition.

stats.description: statistics to compute. Supported: 'median', 'mean', or percentiles like 'p5', 'p95'.

outfun_strata.description: Named strata filters used to subset the dataset (e.g., ARM, SCENARIO). Each property name represents a column and its value the level to select. Use value 'all' to select all levels of a column. Example: {"ARM": "Arm 1", "SCENARIO": "all"} selects all rows where ARM is Arm 1, regardless of SCENARIO.
